neighbours.label: the word 'access' in any sense (access, Access, accessed, all-access), but not synonyms like entry, admission or getting in
fire: You need a badge to access the server room after six.
The hackers accessed thousands of customer records overnight.
She bought an all-access pass for the music festival.
Rural towns still lack reliable access to clean water.
Open the database in Microsoft Access and run the query.
The cabin is only accessible by boat, so access is limited in winter.
Students get free access to the journal through the library.
My password expired, so I can't access my email.
quiet: You need a badge to enter the server room after six.
The hackers stole thousands of customer records overnight.
She bought a weekend pass for the music festival.
Rural towns still struggle to obtain clean water.
Open the spreadsheet in Excel and run the formula.
The cabin can only be reached by boat, so visits are limited in winter.
Students can read the journal for free through the library.
My password expired, so I can't log in to my email.
neighbours.notes: Fire and near-miss sentences written blind by a second author who saw only the label (stream blind_test). Probing: 'access'/'Access' ~0.85, 'accessed' 0.59, 'accessible' 0.34, 'Accessories' (Access+ories) 0.83, single-token 'accessory' 0.08, synonyms (enter, entry, admission, let in) <= 0.03. globalMOO inverse search found no leak.
